// Win32 APIs source-generated by Microsoft.Windows.CsWin32 (SPEC §12: all platform
// invocation is source-generated and confined to this one place). Add the function,
// constant, or struct name on its own line; the generator produces the declaration.
//
// Keep this list minimal — every entry should be traceable to a feature:
//   display identity   -> QueryDisplayConfig / DisplayConfigGetDeviceInfo (SPEC §5)
//   power management   -> SetThreadExecutionState (SPEC §6, display-sleep row)
//   session events     -> WTSRegisterSessionNotification (SPEC §6)
//   shutdown blocking  -> ShutdownBlockReasonCreate (SPEC §6)
//   process adoption   -> GetProcessTimes / QueryFullProcessImageName (SPEC §4)
//   credential storage -> CredRead / CredWrite / CredDelete (SPEC §7)
//
// (Populated as the corresponding work packages are implemented.)

// --- True pixel size of a display, independent of this process's DPI awareness.
// DXGI's DesktopCoordinates are virtual-desktop coordinates, which Windows SCALES
// for a process that is not per-monitor DPI aware; EnumDisplaySettings reports the
// mode the hardware is actually in. See DisplayEnumerator.PhysicalSize.

// --- Free space for ANY folder: UNC shares and folder mount points included.
// System.IO.DriveInfo accepts only drive letters, so every UNC destination and UNC
// working folder failed in it; see Common/FreeSpace.
GetDiskFreeSpaceEx

// --- Handle-based power requests. SetThreadExecutionState belongs to the calling
// THREAD, and a recording's async code runs on whichever pool thread is free; a power
// request belongs to its handle. See WindowsEvents/ExecutionStateHolder.

PowerClearRequest
REASON_CONTEXT
POWER_REQUEST_CONTEXT_FLAGS
POWER_REQUEST_CONTEXT_VERSION
// Read-only: lets the tests observe the machine's real execution state.
